facts.fact: UNDP says Zambia is in the first cohort of its timbuktoo EDGE network of sovereign AI compute, with its node hosted at the University of Zambia AI UniPod, where a prototype non-revenue-water platform for the Lusaka Water Supply and Sanitation Company is to be built.
